name: Vegetable Tempura
steps: Slice sweet potato thinly and cut zucchini and pepper into strips. Keep small mushrooms whole; dry all vegetables thoroughly.
Heat oil to 175°C in a deep pan, no more than half full. Combine flours, baking powder and salt.
Add ice-cold water and stir briefly, leaving small lumps. Coat vegetables and fry in small batches for 3–4 minutes until crisp.
Drain on a rack; check sweet potato is tender inside. Combine soy sauce and vinegar as a dip and serve immediately.
tips: The listed frying oil is a bath, not oil absorbed; keep batter cold and avoid overmixing.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
